title: Australian Pancakes with Flaxseed
description: A delicious and healthy twist on traditional pancakes, infused with the nutty flavor of flaxseed and the charm of Australian spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flaxseeds and milk. Let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
Add the Australian Pancakes Mix, egg, and melted butter to the bowl. Mix until well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.
